narrative: Material PL1__M71A33FE shows smooth, normally distributed demand (CV=0.295) with no significant trend over 134 working days. Lead times are highly variable (CV=0.693), driven predominantly by transport, warranting a safety stock of 381,201 units at the 95% service level. The EOQ-based (r,Q) policy consolidates ~4,148 annual micro-orders under the current SAP MOQ-only approach into ~119 larger replenishments, cutting total annual inventory cost by 88% from $310,900 to $36,835 while respecting the 887,714-unit storage capacity constraint.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth, continuously-positive demand with known lead time distribution suits a continuous-review (r,Q) policy: trigger a fixed replenishment of EOQ units whenever inventory falls to the reorder point, balancing ordering and holding costs optimally.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Safety stock + EOQ (740,520 units) consumes 83.4% of max storage (887,714 units), leaving 147,194 units of buffer headroom. No capacity cap binds at current parameters, but any upward revision to safety stock or EOQ should be re-checked against the capacity gate.
